name: Neoproterozoic
summary: Huqf basin development, glacigenic Abu Mahara, Nafun postglacial sedimentation, and Ara evaporite/carbonate deposition.

name: Paleozoic
summary: Haima siliciclastic basin fill, Paleozoic platform evolution, and Late Carboniferous glaciogenic Haushi deposition.

name: Triassic–Jurassic
summary: Carbonate platform evolution and Sahtan sequence development in central Oman.

name: Early–Late Cretaceous
summary: Carbonate ramps, Shu’aiba platform settings, Natih intrashelf organic-rich facies.

name: Late Cretaceous
summary: Semail ophiolite formation and obduction; timing and subduction models remain debated.

name: Cenozoic
summary: Post-obduction uplift, exhumation, landscape development and modern deformation.
